rows.en:
Hm, I suppose that's true.
Then let's try Western food today.
You don't want Japanese food this time?

Some days my tongue just craves beef.
Or would you have preferred fish?
No, I'm fine with anything!

Sigh... You're easy to please.
Why not try showing a bit more initiative?
Well, fine... Let's go to the restaurant.
Thanks for the meal!

Judging by that face, I take it
you had no complaints about the food.
You really do know all the good places, Sensei.
Not really... Well then, shall we head home?
(I'm stuffed, and it was a nice change of pace.)

(Today I'm going to Yamashiro-sensei's
favorite restaurant again~)
Yes. I don't know any places at all.
No, anything's fine with me!
(I'm stuffed! That was a nice change of pace~)

(I'm going shopping with
Yamashiro-sensei today.)

\p.
You're early again today.

Being five minutes early is
basic stuff for a student, after all.
Hahaha, I see. That's a fine attitude.

Today we're picking out a toy
for your kitten, right?
That's right. Well then, shall we go?
How's the kitten doing?

Fine. At first it was as timid as a borrowed
cat, quite literally, but now it's so lively
that it's become a bit of a handful.
rows.notes: Idiom karite kita neko (a borrowed cat = unusually meek); the kitten was literally taken in. Kept the image with 'quite literally'.

rows.en:
I can't be there for it all the time.
I'd better buy it a toy or something
to keep it in a good mood.
Let me meet it sometime, okay?
Yes, all right.
So, what kind of toy are you going to buy?

Let's see...
Something it can play with on its own would be good...
Hm? Is that...!?
Did you find something?

Sorry, but go on ahead
to the pet supplies section.
Something urgent has come up.
Hey, wait! Sensei!!
You can't just run off like that, Sensei.
Sorry...
You could've at least said something.

I could hardly drag you along with me.
Not for an errand like that.

Why not?
I'd have gone along for something like that.

Yes... I never imagined I'd find it
in a place like this.

The limited-edition reprint
of the Complete VF Collection...
...You look happy.
I've been searching for it for five years...
F-five years...
It was a long wait...
Now then, let's go buy the cat's toy.

(That was fun! I even found out about
Sensei's surprising hobby!)

(Today I'm going shopping
with Yamashiro-sensei.)
Ehehe.

Today we're picking out a toy for
the kitty from last time, right?
How's the kitty doing?
Please let me meet it sometime!
If you'd just said something...

Oh, who minds?
It's something you've wanted for ages, right?
Five years...

(We got a toy for the kitty, and I found out
about Sensei's surprising hobby. So fun!)

(I came shopping with Yamashiro-sensei
again today, but...)
Aren't you hunting for rare finds today?

If they were easy to find, they wouldn't
be rare finds. I do try to keep
an eye out, though...

Never mind me. Let's go look
for the cat's toy right away.
Ah, wait for me~
I'm glad we found a good toy.

Indeed. Now I should be able to
live in safety for a while.
Safety?

It claws up the whole house.
It's quite an ordeal.

I'd better hurry home and get
on its good side.
Okay. See you, Sensei.

Don't go wandering around.
Head straight home.
(Having a pet sure is tough.)
(Keeping a pet really is a lot of work.)

uncertain: c06387: idiom karite kita neko ('a borrowed cat', i.e. unusually meek) applied literally to the adopted kitten; rendered 'as timid as a borrowed cat, quite literally'.
c06399 'Sorry...' is shared with Kagura turning down an invitation (nml_kgr_017); neutral wording works for both.
c06404: 'gentei fukkokuban VF zenshuu' rendered 'the limited-edition reprint of the Complete VF Collection' (no glossary entry; generic product, not a name).
c06398: 'komarimasu yo, sensei' (after Yamashiro ran off) rendered 'You can't just run off like that, Sensei.'
